headline: Solve more connection issues on the first call without handing bookings to a machine
capabilities: Guide agents through the right fix for each customer's service
Check local work and past visits before sending a technician
Prepare each job with the fault history and the parts to bring
Keep a person in control of every technician booking
outcomes: Solved more connection issues on the first call
Avoided unneeded truck rolls during area outages
Sent technicians who arrived prepared for the fault
Put technicians where they add the most value
why_try: The demo lets a contact center agent ask a natural question mid-call and receive a source-backed guided fix, with the booking boundary visible in the response.

sample_prompts.label: Contact Center Agent: Guided connection fix
sample_prompts.prompt: The customer on Alder Grove Service keeps dropping. What guided fix should I walk them through right now?

sample_prompts.label: Contact Center Agent: Local work check
sample_prompts.prompt: Is there any network work near Meadow Lane that could explain the outage?

sample_prompts.label: Field Service Dispatcher: Previous visit review
sample_prompts.prompt: What did the last technician find at Alder Grove Service?

sample_prompts.label: Field Service Dispatcher: Technician booking draft
sample_prompts.prompt: If the light stays red, which technician should go to Alder Grove and what should they prepare? Don't book it yet.

business_flow: Contact center agents and field service dispatchers
Dynamics 365 Customer Service and service status
Network work and Dynamics 365 Field Service visit history
